Inspired by the colours of Lake Como and the Lecco sky, the new jersey offers a contemporary reinterpretation of the city’s symbolic elements, transforming them into a distinctive design that combines tradition, a sense of belonging and innovation. The new shirt features a light blue base crossed by four vertical blue stripes. Within these stripes lies an exclusive graphic inspired by the waves of the lake, an iconic feature of the Lecco landscape. The contrast between the blue of the lake and the light blue of the sky creates a colour combination that visually conveys the strong bond between the team and the local area. Great attention has also been paid to the details. The Calcio Lecco 1912 patch, made from fabric with high-definition embroidery, features on the chest, whilst the Acerbis logos, applied via heat transfer to the chest and sleeve, give the jersey a contemporary and high-performance style. The words “Blucelesti” stand out on the back of the collar, a clear reference to the club’s colours and the sense of belonging that binds the team to its supporters and the city. From a technical perspective, the new Home Jersey is made from a special 100% polyester fabric with a unique texture, designed to ensure lightness, comfort and maximum breathability during competitive play. This solution is designed to meet the needs of professional athletes, without compromising on comfort for all the fans who will be wearing the shirt in the stands. With this new design, Acerbis reaffirms its commitment to developing collections that celebrate the history and identity of its partner clubs.
